name: monorepo-gauge
description: Hygiene checks for npm/yarn/pnpm workspaces: circular internal dependencies, internal ranges that no longer match, shared dependency drift, duplicate names, public packages depending on private ones, missing package fields and version drift. Text/JSON/SARIF/Markdown, allowlist with expiry, GitHub Action. Zero deps.

paragraphs: Monorepos rot quietly. A package bumps to 2.0.0 while a sibling still asks for ^1.0.0, so the package manager fetches the old copy from the registry instead of linking the local one. One app moves to React 18 and another stays on 17. Two packages end up importing each other. A published package depends on a private one that users can never install. monorepo-gauge reads your workspace layout and reports these problems with the file, a severity and a concrete fix.
CLI, library and GitHub Action. Node.js 18+, one runtime dependency (pkg-field-gauge). By Louis Wright.
features: Workspace discovery: package.json workspaces (array or { packages }), pnpm-workspace.yaml and lerna.json, with , and !exclusions. The package manager is detected from the lockfile, .yarnrc.yml and packageManager.

Internal graph: cycles through dependencies/peerDependencies/optionalDependencies (high) and through devDependencies (low), each reported once as a → b → c → a. Internal ranges are checked against the local version with…
Shared dependency drift: the same external dependency with different majors (medium) or different ranges in the same major (low) across packages and the root, listing who uses what.

Package fields, delegated to pkg-field-gauge: every workspace runs through pkg-field-gauge's checkPackage (entry points, exports, types, bin, files, licence, repository, description, keywords…) and each result is…

workspace: protocol: mixed workspace:^ / workspace: / workspace: / workspace: styles are flagged (workspace-protocol-inconsistent, majority wins or set workspaceProtocolStyle), and workspace: under npm or yarn classic,…
